guides.title: Sign in
guides.purpose: Use your existing NSIPA account to access the requested service.
guides.steps:
Check the service address and choose the sign-in method shown on the page.
Enter your account details and submit the sign-in form.
Wait for the service to open. If an error appears after sign-in, retain the service name and error message for the administrator; never share your password.
guides.requirements: An active account for the relevant staff or beneficiary service.
guides.next_step: Confirm that the requested service and your own account are shown before continuing.
guides.issues: A successful identity sign-in does not grant access to every service. A callback error or repeated redirect needs administrator investigation; do not create duplicate accounts to resolve it.

guides.title: Profile details
guides.purpose: Review the personal details used by the beneficiary portal.
guides.steps:
Open your profile and check that it belongs to you.
Review the displayed contact and identifying information.
Use the available edit controls for supported corrections and confirm the saved result.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Return to the programme or application that needs the corrected information.
guides.issues: Check the selected record and any active filters. Resolve the displayed validation message before retrying. If access is denied, contact the service administrator; choosing another help role does not change your permissions.

guides.title: Payment account details
guides.purpose: Review the payment account information linked through the available account service.
guides.steps:
Open Accounts and select the relevant account or mapper.
Check the account identity and any verification status shown before entering a correction.
Submit only the changes requested by the form and confirm the returned status. Do not put full account credentials in help or complaint text.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Check the account status before proceeding with a programme application or payment enquiry.
guides.issues: An account link does not itself confirm enrollment or settlement. If linking fails, record the displayed error and contact the authorised support team.

guides.title: Benefit history
guides.purpose: Review the benefits displayed for your registered programmes.
guides.steps:
Select the relevant benefit or programme.
Check the period, amount or quantity and the recorded status.
Open available details to distinguish an entitlement from a completed payment.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Use the application or enquiry workflow if a displayed benefit needs clarification.
guides.issues: A listed benefit is not proof that funds have reached an account. Use the recorded payment status and authorised support process to investigate discrepancies.

guides.title: Complaints and enquiries
guides.purpose: Raise or follow an enquiry about your registration, application or benefit.
guides.steps:
Check whether an enquiry already exists for the issue.
Describe the issue using the relevant application or programme reference and provide only the information requested.
Submit the enquiry and retain its reference so you can follow the response.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Track the enquiry status and respond to requests for additional information.
guides.issues: Do not include passwords or unnecessary financial information. An enquiry does not change eligibility or guarantee payment.

guides.title: Notifications
guides.purpose: Read service messages and identify any action needed on your application.
guides.steps:
Open the notification and check the referenced programme or application.
Read the complete message and any due date shown.
Use the linked service screen to complete the requested action, then check its status.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Return to the related application to confirm the outcome.
guides.issues: Do not treat a message preview as the full instruction. Open the notification before acting and verify unexpected requests with the service administrator.

guides.title: News and announcements
guides.purpose: Read programme announcements without confusing them with an individual application decision.
guides.steps:
Open the announcement and check its date and programme.
Read the full eligibility or application information provided.
Use the programme screen to check whether an application is available to your account.
guides.requirements: Access to the beneficiary portal.
guides.next_step: Track your own application separately from public announcements.
guides.issues: An announcement does not confirm that you are enrolled or entitled to a benefit.

guides.title: Beneficiary dashboard
guides.purpose: Understand the summary of your registrations, applications and benefits.
guides.steps:
Review the summary labels and any active period filter.
Open the relevant application or benefit for its detailed status.
Respond to requested corrections using the related workflow.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Use the detailed record when you need to confirm a decision or payment status.
guides.issues: Summary counts can cover different stages. Do not interpret an application count as an approval or a benefit count as settlement.

guides.title: Registry configuration
guides.purpose: Maintain the registry definitions and forms available to authorised configuration staff.
guides.steps:
Identify the registry, register, data model or intake form being configured.
Review field definitions, required values, labels and existing dependencies before editing.
Save only authorised changes and check the affected form or record screen before using the new configuration.
guides.requirements: Registry configuration permission and an agreed definition of the intended change.
guides.next_step: Verify the resulting fields and validation behaviour in the affected registration workflow.
guides.issues: Changing a label does not migrate stored data. If a change affects existing fields or records, follow the registry administrator’s change process before proceeding.

guides.title: Sharing and approval configuration
guides.purpose: Review the policies that control registry sharing and approval routing.
guides.steps:
Open the intended policy or workflow mapping.
Check its scope, applicable records, decision stages and permitted recipients.
Save authorised changes and confirm the selected policy and status.
guides.requirements: Permission to administer registry policies and the agreed policy requirements.
guides.next_step: Check the affected request workflow using an authorised test record.
guides.issues: Do not broaden data access to resolve an unrelated form error. A policy shown in configuration must also be valid for the applicable workflow.

guides.title: Outgoing message monitoring
guides.purpose: Inspect outgoing registry messages and identify delivery failures.
guides.steps:
Find the message associated with the correct record or request.
Check its destination, event and processing status.
Review the displayed error before using any authorised retry or correction action.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Confirm the resulting delivery status and retain the message reference for unresolved failures.
guides.issues: A queued message is not confirmed receipt by the destination. Avoid repeated retries until the cause of a failure is understood.

guides.title: Outgoing integration configuration
guides.purpose: Maintain the configured topics and templates for outgoing registry integration.
guides.steps:
Select the intended topic or template.
Check its field mappings, destination and expected record type.
Save authorised changes and verify an approved test message before relying on the integration.
guides.requirements: Integration configuration permission and the approved destination schema.
guides.next_step: Inspect outgoing message status for the configured integration.
guides.issues: A template change can affect future messages. Confirm dependencies and avoid using live personal data in troubleshooting examples.

guides.title: Registry profile
guides.purpose: Check the staff profile associated with the current registry session.
guides.steps:
Confirm that the account shown is your own.
Review the available profile information and permitted update controls.
Contact the access administrator if the identity or assigned access is incorrect.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Return to the registry task once the account details are correct.
guides.issues: Profile changes do not automatically grant new registry permissions.

guides.title: Approval simulation
guides.purpose: Test how a policy version routes a supplied example request.
guides.steps:
Confirm the policy and version selected for simulation.
Enter a fictional example that matches the expected request structure.
Run the simulation and inspect the resolved stages and approvers.
guides.requirements: Policy access and a synthetic test request without personal or confidential data.
guides.next_step: Compare the simulated routing with the intended approval design before any policy activation.
guides.issues: Simulation does not approve a live request. A successful example does not prove that every production input resolves correctly.

guides.title: Approval delegation
guides.purpose: Review delegation settings that affect who can act on approval tasks.
guides.steps:
Identify the delegating user and intended substitute.
Check the permitted scope and effective dates shown by the form.
Save only an authorised delegation and confirm its resulting status.
guides.requirements: Permission to administer delegations and the agreed delegation scope.
guides.next_step: Check the affected task assignment after the delegation becomes effective.
guides.issues: Delegation must not be used to avoid independent-review requirements. Check the effective period before assuming a substitute can act.

guides.title: Webhook deliveries
guides.purpose: Follow delivery of approval events to configured receiving services.
guides.steps:
Locate the delivery associated with the relevant approval request.
Review its destination, attempt status and response or error.
Use an available retry only after checking the cause and confirming that the receiving service can safely handle it.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Confirm the final delivery status separately from the approval decision.
guides.issues: An approved request may still have a failed delivery. Repeated delivery is not a new approval and must not be treated as a duplicate decision.

guides.title: Approval audit log
guides.purpose: Inspect recorded approval events to understand the sequence of actions.
guides.steps:
Filter the log to the relevant request, policy or actor.
Read timestamps, action names and related identifiers in sequence.
Open the related request to confirm its current state.
guides.requirements: An account authorised for this service and the correct record or task reference.
guides.next_step: Use the event references when asking the approval administrator to investigate a discrepancy.
guides.issues: An audit event records an action at a point in time; it may not describe the current request state. Avoid including unrelated personal information in exported evidence.

guides.title: Programme analytics
guides.purpose: Review the registration and programme measures available to your staff account.
guides.steps:
Check the reporting period and scope.
Apply the available filters and inspect the chart labels and counts.
Open the underlying workflow when you need to confirm an individual status.
guides.requirements: An account with the required screen permission, where sign-in is requested. Use fictional information for sandbox and demonstration screens.
guides.next_step: Review the resulting screen or report and follow the next action that is actually available.
guides.issues: Demonstration results are not proof of a live integration, eligibility decision or transferred funds. If the screen is unavailable, report the service address and displayed error to the administrator.

guides.title: Partner simulation
guides.purpose: Explore a synthetic integration journey and inspect its recorded outcomes.
guides.steps:
Read the scenario and confirm that all inputs are fictional.
Open an existing run to inspect the recorded steps and outcomes.
If authorised to start a demonstration, review its inputs first and inspect the resulting report afterward.
guides.requirements: An account with the required screen permission, where sign-in is requested. Use fictional information for sandbox and demonstration screens.
guides.next_step: Review the resulting screen or report and follow the next action that is actually available.
guides.issues: Demonstration results are not proof of a live integration, eligibility decision or transferred funds. If the screen is unavailable, report the service address and displayed error to the administrator.

Read the screen instructions and use only fictional records.

guides.title: Partner consent bindings
guides.purpose: Review the association between a partner and the policy that limits its access.
guides.steps:
Open the partner binding and check the partner, policy and applicable scope.
Before creating a binding, confirm that the intended partner and policy are correct.
Save only an authorised change and verify the resulting binding.
guides.requirements: An authorised consent-management account and the correct partner or request reference.
guides.next_step: Confirm the current request, policy and consent state before continuing with the related sharing workflow.
guides.issues: If no record appears, check the selected filters and account permissions. Consent approval does not approve programme enrollment or payment. Ask the service administrator to investigate inconsistent or unavailable records.

guides.title: Consent approvals
guides.purpose: Review consent-related requests awaiting an authorised decision.
guides.steps:
Open the relevant request and inspect its partner, purpose and requested scope.
Check the supporting information and the decision controls available to your account.
Record an authorised decision only after completing the required checks, then confirm the resulting status.
guides.requirements: An authorised consent-management account and the correct partner or request reference.
guides.next_step: Confirm the current request, policy and consent state before continuing with the related sharing workflow.
guides.issues: If no record appears, check the selected filters and account permissions. Consent approval does not approve programme enrollment or payment. Ask the service administrator to investigate inconsistent or unavailable records.

guides.title: Consent decisions
guides.purpose: Inspect the consent decisions recorded for a sharing request.
guides.steps:
Locate the relevant decision using the available filters.
Read its outcome, scope and related identifiers.
Use the linked request or policy to investigate discrepancies without assuming that a past decision grants permanent access.
guides.requirements: An authorised consent-management account and the correct partner or request reference.
guides.next_step: Confirm the current request, policy and consent state before continuing with the related sharing workflow.
guides.issues: If no record appears, check the selected filters and account permissions. Consent approval does not approve programme enrollment or payment. Ask the service administrator to investigate inconsistent or unavailable records.
